visual_review.summary: All nine mathematical pages were individually inspected at1.7x. All26groups complete, coherent12pt main/11pt supplement with70% scripts, compact upright operators and descriptive labels, groupwise relation anchors aligned, readable inline counts and no collisions. S7 logical disjunction is a visible vee symbol. DOCX/native structures and PDF are checked; Microsoft Word/WPS were not run.

limits: The final PDF was rendered with the task-specific LibreOffice math profile and inspected. Native DOCX structure uses Cambria Math and editable OMML; Microsoft Word and WPS were not directly run in this environment.

Inline summation limits are vertically stacked in this PDF renderer but remain readable and do not collide with adjacent text. No mathematical formulas, results or cohort data were changed for typography.
